subtitle: Master the rhythmic precision and harmonic sophistication of funk guitar through theory-based analysis

columns.title: Rhythmic Foundation
columns.text: Funk guitar is built on precise rhythmic execution and strategic use of silence. Understanding syncopation, ghost notes, and the emphasis on "the one" is crucial for authentic funk feel.

columns.title: Harmonic Color
columns.text: Extended chords (7ths, 9ths, 11ths) provide the sophisticated harmonic palette that distinguishes funk from simpler rock styles, while maintaining groove primacy.

cards.title: The Muted Strum
cards.description: Percussive attack with immediate muting for tight rhythmic feel

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Creates rhythmic punctuation without harmonic information

fields.label: Application
fields.value: Essential for funk's characteristic "chops" and rhythmic drive

cards.title: Ghost Notes
cards.description: Subtle strums between main beats that add rhythmic texture

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Provides subdivisions that enhance groove without clutter

fields.label: Application
fields.value: Fills rhythmic space and maintains momentum between accents

cards.title: Chord Stabs
cards.description: Sharp, accented chord attacks on specific beats

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Emphasizes important harmonic moments and creates dynamic contrast

fields.label: Application
fields.value: Punctuates rhythm section and creates call-and-response with bass

cards.title: Wah-Wah Integration
cards.description: Using wah pedal to enhance rhythmic and tonal expression

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Filters frequencies to create vowel-like sounds and tonal variation

fields.label: Application
fields.value: Adds expressiveness and creates the classic funk guitar voice

cards.title: Extended Chord Harmony

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Funk relies heavily on 7th, 9th, and 11th chords. These extensions add color and sophistication while maintaining the groove-oriented foundation.

items: Am7 - adds the minor 7th (G) to Am triad
Cmaj7 - major 7th creates smooth, sophisticated sound

cards.title: Syncopation and Rhythmic Displacement

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Funk emphasizes off-beats and creates tension by placing accents away from expected strong beats, particularly emphasizing the "one".

items: Beat 1 emphasis with rests on beats 2-4
Sixteenth note subdivisions with strategic muting
Cross-rhythms that play against the bass line

cards.title: Voice Leading in Chord Progressions

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Smooth movement between chord tones, often using common tones and step-wise motion to maintain flow while changing harmony.

items: Am7 to D7 - G note common to both chords
Cmaj7 to Fmaj7 - C moves to D (step-wise)
Circle of fifths progressions with 7th chords

steps.title: Basic Rhythm
steps.description: Master simple muted strumming patterns and basic 7th chord shapes. Focus on consistent timing and clean muting.

steps.title: Syncopation
steps.description: Add ghost notes and off-beat accents. Learn to emphasize "the one" while maintaining steady groove.

steps.title: Advanced Harmony
steps.description: Incorporate extended chords, voice leading, and effects. Develop personal style while maintaining groove foundation.
